_comment: Special-case rules the auto-refresh must honor. Edit this file to add new rules; the script reads it on every run.
_exclude_ids_note: HubSpot IDs to drop entirely (test deals, duplicates, deals marked 'please ignore'). The refresh will neither insert nor update these.
_dealname_prefix_note: HubSpot ID -> prefix always kept on the Deal Name. Example: El Paso County stays prefixed [Shared Award].
_force_remove_from_awards_note: HubSpot IDs that should never appear in the Awards sheet even if their stage says Closed Won / Intent to Award.
